help.zh-CN: Deer 原生单图背景链接。若在下方“背景与外观”里配置了多图/视频，将由外观脚本接管背景。
help.en-US: Deer's native single background image. If multi-image/video is configured below, the appearance script takes over the background.

name.zh-CN: 背景与外观（多图 / 视频）
桌面端背景图（随机轮换）

help.zh-CN: 上传多张图片，每次刷新页面时将随机抽取一张展示。留空则降级使用下方的桌面端单图设置。
help.en-US: Upload multiple images; one is picked at random on each page refresh. Leave empty to fall back to the desktop single image below.

name.zh-CN: 移动端背景图（随机轮换）

help.zh-CN: 移动端（竖屏）随机多图设置，留空则降级使用下方的移动端单图设置。
help.en-US: Random multi-image set for mobile (portrait). Leave empty to fall back to the mobile single image below.

name.zh-CN: 桌面端背景图片链接（单图）

help.zh-CN: 单张背景图片或图片 API。使用“|”分隔亮色和暗色模式，填写单个则亮暗共用（eg: https://test.com/1.png）。
help.en-US: A single background image or image API. Separate light and dark with "|"; a single value is used for both (e.g. https://test.com/1.png).

name.zh-CN: 移动端背景图片链接（单图）

help.zh-CN: 移动端背景图片链接，与桌面端一样区分亮暗模式，留空则使用桌面端背景。
help.en-US: Mobile background image URL, light/dark like desktop. Leave empty to use the desktop background.

help.zh-CN: 格式为“size,position”，如 cover,center / cover,top / contain,center / fill,center。作为每张图未单独设置时的回退值。
help.en-US: Format "size,position", e.g. cover,center / cover,top / contain,center / fill,center. Used as the fallback when a per-image value is not set.

help.zh-CN: 启用后将使用视频作为背景（在图片层之上）。
help.en-US: When enabled, a video is used as the background (above the image layer).

help.zh-CN: 视频背景链接（eg: https://test.com/1.mp4），使用“|”分隔亮暗模式。建议使用无声视频，文件较大可能影响加载。
help.en-US: Video background URL (e.g. https://test.com/1.mp4); separate light/dark with "|". Prefer muted videos; large files may slow loading.

help.zh-CN: 移动端视频背景链接，留空则使用桌面端视频。
help.en-US: Mobile video background URL; leave empty to use the desktop video.

help.zh-CN: 格式为“object-fit,position”，如 cover,center。留空则回退到上方的背景对齐方式。
help.en-US: Format "object-fit,position", e.g. cover,center. Leave empty to fall back to Background Alignment above.

help.zh-CN: 推荐 rgba 颜色值，使用“|”分隔亮暗模式（eg: rgba(255,255,255,0.5)|rgba(0,0,0,0.5)）。经脚本注入为 CSS 变量供主题消费。
help.en-US: Recommended rgba values, split light/dark with "|" (e.g. rgba(255,255,255,0.5)|rgba(0,0,0,0.5)). Injected as CSS variables for the theme to consume.

help.zh-CN: 数值越大模糊越明显，建议 5-20，0 表示不模糊。经脚本注入为 CSS 变量 --purcarte-blur 供主题消费。
help.en-US: Larger values blur more; 5-20 recommended, 0 disables. Injected as the CSS variable --purcarte-blur for the theme to consume.
